facts.text: DLR Framing Cameras (FC) was deployed at Ceres & Vesta — Perpetual Orbit during Dawn in 2007.
Twin redundant refractive telephoto framing cameras built by the German Aerospace Center (DLR) with 1024x1024 CCD arrays.
Engineered specifically to operate in the harsh vacuum and extreme temperatures of the lunar environment.
Captured over 100,000 high-resolution images, charting Rheasilvia crater's central peak (one of the tallest mountains in the Solar System).
Status: Remains preserved in the arid regolith at Ceres & Vesta — Perpetual Orbit.
Delivered the first comprehensive geological atlases of Vesta and Ceres.
